heroSub: We empower youth and underserved communities through education, skill development, and holistic growth — building a more progressive and sustainable India.
heroImageAlt: Youth participants in digital skilling session at Megh Foundation
youthTagline: By the youth, for the youth
youthBody: Youth understand youth better than anyone else. By empowering them to lead, we ensure solutions stay relevant, impactful, and sustainable — building confidence, responsibility, and purpose.
transformTitle: Empowering youth to build a better tomorrow
transformBody: We don't just train — we transform. Each young person who walks through our programs walks out job-ready, confident, and connected.
inclusivityBody: Youth are the driving force of a progressive and inclusive society. When every young person can participate, lead, and shape the future, communities grow stronger.
pillarsIntroTitle: What we mean by youth empowerment
pillarsIntroBody: Youth is not simply an age bracket — it is a stage of becoming. We work with young people ages 8–30, from children building their first sense of self to rural graduates entering the workforce.
csrTitle: Don't just donate. Invest in India's future.
csrLead: Real change happens on the ground. Every program starts with listening to communities, understanding what employers need, and building skills that lead to jobs.
csrPoint1Body: Programs are co-designed with communities and aligned to local hiring demand — not generic slides in a boardroom.
csrPoint2Body: We work at the intersection of education, employment, and community development — a pipeline of job-ready youth who lift everyone around them.
csrPoint3Body: No nation grows by leaving its youth behind. Your CSR capital becomes measurable skills, placements, and dignity.
partnerTitle: Be a part of the journey toward a Developing India
partnerBody: Every contribution fuels progress — helping individuals grow, communities thrive, and shaping a stronger Developing India. Our CSR partners receive transparent impact reports, including placement outcomes and real youth feedback.
address: SF-73, City Mall 2, Navjivan Complex, Kalol -Gandhinagar  - 382721).
aboutMissionBody: Megh Foundation is dedicated to holistic youth development. We equip young people with knowledge, skills, and values to build a more progressive and sustainable India — with a focus on rural and underserved communities.
aboutStoryBody: Rural youth often remain unemployed or underemployed due to limited access to digital and practical skills. Even graduates may lack interview readiness and employer-aligned training. We bridge that gap with hands-on programs and mentorship.
aboutValuesBody: We combine digital literacy, soft skills, volunteering, and leadership development so youth can earn, contribute, and lead with confidence.
contactIntro: Have questions about CSR, donations, or volunteering? Reach out — we respond within two business days.
donateIntro: Your support funds training, materials, devices where needed, and placement support. 80G and impact reporting can be shared as applicable — mention it in your message.

footerMediaText: For media, due diligence packs, or registration details, email us with your organisation name and timeline.

faqs.question: What is Megh Foundation?
faqs.answer: A non-profit focused on holistic youth development — especially in rural and underserved India — through skills, education, and leadership.

faqs.question: What problem are you solving?
faqs.answer: Underemployment linked to missing digital, interview, and workplace skills. We train to what employers actually hire for, with placement support.

faqs.question: How are CSR funds used?
faqs.answer: Training delivery, trainers, materials, devices where required, assessments, and placement support — with transparent budgets and reporting.

faqs.question: Do you share impact reports?
faqs.answer: Yes. Baseline at the start and endline after programs, including placement metrics, attendance, and anonymized youth feedback.

faqs.question: Can programs be customized?
faqs.answer: We co-design with CSR partners around geography, sector, and workforce needs — timelines typically start within a few weeks of alignment.
